newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in london rise on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in london rise on bargain hunting.

text.p: Japanese shares trading in London were slightly higher Monday as bargain-hunters stepped in, though dealers noted profit-taking in some blue-chip issues.
"It has been a relatively quiet day," said one trader. "But overall I've seen net buying today on bargain hunting."
The Nikkei/Ise 50 index in London was up 17.79 points at 1,445.18 by 1503 GMT.

Tokyo stocks closed the first trading day of the year modestly higher on Monday, helped by selective buying in blue-chip shares. The Nikkei-225 share average finished the half-day session 84.65 points higher at 19,446.00.
"Blue-chips will probably continue to outperform in Tokyo but I expect the market to drift off," one trader said.

In London, investors took profits in selected blue-chips which have been outperforming recently. Honda Motor was down 22.5 yen at 3,327.5 yen in London after a Tokyo close of 3,340 and Toyota was quoted at 3,340 yen, down from 3,350 in Tokyo. Elsewhere dealers noted weakness in some bank stocks and bargain hunting in some recent market laggards.
